sam_eval: Heads-up from the q8b-int4 bring-up: our rerank benchmark (RR@5 on support-search) dropped ~6% vs q8b-fp16. The hit seems correlated with certain multi-paragraph queries where embeddings cluster differently. Suspect quantization-induced embedding drift + a pre-token normalization change in the sampling pipeline.

sam_eval: Two representative failures (shortened):
- id 902112: query 'How to restore deleted project files across git history when commit messages are noisy' -> baseline reranks the PR thread items top, q8b-int4 puts unrelated tutorial pages higher.
- id 902145: query 'refund policy for subscription prorate' -> q8b-int4 surfaces internal playbook draft instead of policy summary.

sam_eval: Ran an embedding delta check: `python tools/emb_diff.py --base q8b-fp16 --cand q8b-int4 --ids 902112,902145` shows cosine shifts ~0.12 and several tokens normalized differently before tokenization.

sam_eval: command: `scripts/eval_rerank.sh --model q8b-int4 --holdout rerank_5k.json --metrics rr@1,rr@5,ndcg`

tara_labelops: Do we know which stage changed normalization? The sampling pipeline recently swapped "normalize_unicode" -> "nfkc" and added whitespace collapse on ingest to reduce duplicates. If that happened post-golden, we could be mismatching gold fingerprints.

leo_infra: deploy-bot reports the q8b-int4 canary ramped to 15% in staging earlier today. No infra errors but CPU tail increased because of extra preproc for normalization. I can pin production to q8b-fp16 while we triage.

deploy-bot: [system] Deployed q8b-int4 to staging at 2025-11-02T10:03:12Z. Canary ramp: 1% -> 15%. Monitoring: increased embedding variance metric flagged by evalers.

nina_prod: We should also check the dedupe/shingling step. If pre-token normalization changed, the fingerprinting used by dedupe (rolling-sha window) could drop collision rates and cause formerly-deduped gold to appear in holdouts. That would both inflate holdout difficulty and leak gold answers.

sam_eval: Agreed. Proposed plan: 1) run 2k A/B rerank test stratified by doc-length and intent 2) run pre-tokenization fingerprint comparison between current ingest and previous snapshot for the holdout set 3) queue 150 micro-gold relabels for true positives where embeddings changed but gold still valid.

sam_eval: eval command for A/B:
```
python eval/ab_rerank.py --models q8b-fp16,q8b-int4 --holdout rerank_strat2k.json --out ab_q8b_rerank_results.json
```

tara_labelops: We can spin up the micro-golden job. Need the prioritized id list. If fingerprints match existing gold (sha1 normalized text), we exclude from relabel to avoid wasting label capacity. ETA for 150: start tomorrow AM, finish ~36h depending on annotator throughput.

leo_infra: For mitigation, suggest a routing rule: when rerank_request.doc_tokens > 2048 OR rerank_confidence_drop > 0.15 route to q8b-fp16. I can implement that as a toggle in the console; will also add a telemetry flag to mark requests that hit the fallback so we can quantify impact.

nina_prod: Also create a short-lived sampling job to replay ingest for the last 2 weeks using old normalization code to measure fingerprint collision delta: `jobs/replay_ingest.py --from 2025-10-18 --to 2025-11-01 --norm old` 

sam_eval: Sample IDs for triage: 902112, 902145, 902201, 902333, 902410, 902478, 902501. SQL I used to pull long queries:
```
SELECT id, length_chars, intent, fingerprint FROM promptset_ingest
WHERE length_chars > 1500
AND intent IN ('support-search','policy-search','longtech')
AND created_at >= '2025-10-15'
ORDER BY length_chars DESC
LIMIT 1000;
```

tara_labelops: Copy. We'll run fingerprint dedupe check pre-label and post-label to ensure micro-gold excludes leaked gold. Also pinging annotators who specialized in policy/support taxonomy.

leo_infra: I'll add the routing toggle and replay job by EOD. We'll keep q8b-fp16 pinned in prod until A/B completes.

sam_eval: Thanks. I'll kick off the A/B now and upload interim metrics in a few hours. If the cosine shift median >0.08 we escalate to a model rollback.

tara_labelops: Acknowledged 44d will post job links and progress updates here.

nina_prod: Good plan. Also log a Postmortem ticket if we end up rolling back so we capture ingestion vs quant stack blame matrix.

sam_eval: Copy. Thread updated with commands and IDs. Thanks team.
